title: MAID REWORK MAID FOR BLOOD GAME
author: Maidforblood
selftext:
in this video, i made a short video update demo of my game, reworked the maid character. new content are now inside the current game. v8.8.85.31 tools used - > Claude code opus 5.5, Chat GPT 6 Astra, and ElevenLabs.

**Blood Pacts:** buffs and debuffs change the experience each run.

**Lucienne Vesper’s evolved Parasol Needle:** needles stick to enemies and stack.

**Needle Conversion:** projectile weapon cards become extra needles, banishing the converted weapon for that hunt.

**Needle Burst:** pressing **E** triggers burst damage; kills reset its cooldown.

Multiple needles hitting one target multiply damage, while airborne needles retarget when their target dies.

my original narration, captions, section titles, and gameplay demonstrations guide the roughly two-minute showcase.

game version v8.8.85.31 play it yourself and see if you had fun with her!
